Which statement explains why isotopes of the same element have the same chemical properties?
A
They have the same electronic structure.
B
They have the same relative mass.
C
They have the same nucleon number.
D
They have the same proton number.

options.label: A
options.text: They have the same electronic structure.

options.label: B
options.text: They have the same relative mass.

options.label: C
options.text: They have the same nucleon number.

options.label: D
options.text: They have the same proton number.
